verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is a documented partner platform for embedding payroll into your own product. It offers system access tokens for creating partner-managed companies, full payroll and tax processing APIs, pre-built UI flows, a customizable React SDK, official client libraries, and webhooks. The docs stress a tailored experience inside the partner's platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of white-label branding and removal of Gusto branding, and independent or hands-on corroboration from embedded partners (the community evidence covers only the direct Gusto product).
